instrumentAmendments.reason: Cross-review found NaN reference metrics could pass the perturbation checker, and unsupported repolarization could receive a peak time. Reject nonfinite references and return null timing below the existing support floor. No threshold, model or seed changed; preserve v1 outputs and rerun v2.

purpose: Descriptive characterization of final QRS–ST–T relationships; no model selection or clinical validation

windows.anchor: production beat.time (QRS onset); beat.qrs and beat.qt are durations in seconds, not annotations
windows.j60: J + 0.060 seconds; nearest final sample, null if beyond QT end
windows.repolarization: [J + 0.040, onset + qt], inclusive sample centers; not an independently delineated T wave
windows.peak: largest absolute baseline-referred sample in repolarization window, retaining sign
windows.halfHeightWidth: contiguous same-polarity support at >= half peak; null when either crossing lies outside window

thresholdInterpretation: Numerical support guards only; not clinical normal ranges, not minimum clinical improvement
analysisUnit: median of eligible beats per seed/variant/lead; seeds are synthetic recordings, never patients
negativeControls: scale 1.7 multiplies amplitudes/areas, preserves dimensionless ratios and widths
polarity -1 reverses signed metrics, preserves ratios of signed quantities only where defined and absolute widths
truncated/nonfinite/overlapping windows return null with reason
retention: Keep every recording, every excluded beat, all null reasons, coverage, warnings and negative-control failures

acceptance.auditInstrument: Analytic fixture tests and all evaluable final-sample negative controls pass; report inadequate coverage rather than infer fidelity
acceptance.modelCorrection: Not eligible in this protocol: no untouched independently calibrated and delineated external reserve, no predefined external effect size or noninferiority margins
acceptance.clinicalPlausibilityPromotion: Requires external evidence and independent human clinical review; synthetic descriptive agreement is insufficient

limitations: Natural values apply only to NORM; BBB natural/default comparison is an identity control
Configured/default versus natural changes several controls and does not isolate normalization
All phases remain normalized/transformed by production synthesis; latent model covariance is not final waveform covariance
No T onset annotation: J60 may overlap T and is never automatically classified as pure ST
Fixed-rate, ideal acquisition panel does not evaluate noise, rate adaptation, other families or rendering
